as_told.title: Letters and former navy officers tell Asberg of objects crashed into the water

plain: A Swedish treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg, who says he found a strange object on the seafloor, tells Jesse Michels's podcast that since 2011 he has received many emails and even paper letters from people around the world. According to Asberg, they describe cigar-shaped objects that crashed into water and into forests, and some of the people writing to him were former navy officers. He tells it because, if true, it would mean such crashes are seen far more often than people know.
